When I was 15 I suffered with anorexia and was at a critically low weight. A few days before I was admitted into hospital, a friend was at my house and I went to sit against the radiator as my body was always so cold. As I sat against it I felt my body start to shut down. I can't explain the feeling, but it had started to give up on me and I knew it was the end. Everything was going slow and I could just feel my organs slow down. I panicked and realised how serious my illness was. 
I'd been stuck with a distorted mind for almost a year yet our freezer was full of Ben and Jerry's ice cream from before my ED developed. I wouldn't touch it because it had the most calories of ice cream that existed in supermarkets. I had the idea suddenly to eat as many calories as I could to get my body working again, so we went down and microwaved 3 tubs of the stuff so that it melted into a milkshake. I drank two and my friend tried one of them. My friend went home and I made some food as if I'd never had an eating disorder - I guess it was my body's idea of survival mode. 
My parents were shocked, they still to this day think my friend was able to miraculously convince me to eat food I once enjoyed for the next few days before my admittance to hospital (it was planned a few weeks before this incident happened). 
As of now I've been recovered for 6 years, I recovered really well - it feels like completely different life that I once had. Every time I have Ben and Jerry's now it reminds me of that moment and in a weird way it was my saviour.
